title: Prove a rank-sensitive crossing constraint for P104 relay corrections
body:
## Summary

PR2604 permits legal dirty `{1,7,1}` arrivals and asks for a joint contact/profile constraint. Add a scoped proof and registered replay for that constraint in the frozen-path, X-only monotone P104 correction model.

```text
4,992 nonzero correction entries
  remove 312 possible original-source/target bypasses at dimension cut 4
4,680 entries cross on new helpers
  rank-r crossing capacity <= 2^(7-r)
64 n1 + 32 n2 + 16 n3 + 8 n4 + 4 n5 + 2 n6 + n7 >= 4680
```

Consequences: homogeneous rank multiset `{1,1,7}` requires at least 4,680 lifetimes; any design with at most 482 lifetimes requires at least 67 other multisets. This repairs a pricing implication while retaining a legal arbitrary-dirty carrier as a positive control. It does not improve the unrestricted 208-lifetime floor or establish a complete cost, supplier or new kappa.

One package contains the written path/rectangle proof, two separately implemented finite checkers, exact source pins/receipt, public-CLI controls and open next questions. Original helpers/private reads, target feedback, changed original data paths and new helper descents are excluded.

## Evidence

- **Before:** an individual cheap shape was legal, but its feasibility did not justify a small homogeneous network or the earlier uniform shape exclusion. **After:** all seven source/target bypass sets are reconstructed exactly. The cut-4 residual is 4,680; dropping either bypass would incorrectly claim 4,824. The universal implication is a written proof with checked finite premises, not an exhaustive network search or formal-kernel theorem.
- Optimized CPython 3.12.15 and 3.14.8 primary/independent replays pass. Registered replay includes seven tests for unchanged Git-free export, source/receipt corruption, duplicate keys, input capacity and exclusive output. Four actual dirty-carrier faults reject. The affine capacity positive case and missing-parity countermodel distinguish essential hypotheses.
- All 65 repository research workflow tests pass, with three skips. Source/provenance checks, baseline bindings, Ruff E/F/I/B/UP and whitespace checks pass. Separate internal proof review caught and fixed the original-target bypass and restored-helper reuse details. No independent human review is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-relay-crossing-capacity
```

Scientific pins remain at main `0fdd7d82`; the isolated branch was fast-forwarded to refreshed main `b4560d9e`, priority revision 5. Its family gate is recorded in TASK.json: finish this audit, then stop before any construction expansion without a complete budget. Final overlap covered 819 open PRs and 1,279 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside that search.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18953398). Exact assignment, heads, commands, environment and remaining obligations are in TASK.json. Credit Philippe Van Velzen's relay-v2 screen, Nick Petalas/PR2604, ywz65/PR2614, kumagi/PR2353 and the Rohan Arun/PR1972, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Adam Gall/PR1940, Josie Elliston/PR1071, Ali Romman/PR1125 lineage. PR2392's no-relay cover and PR2633's navigation map have different scope. Existing source attribution and licenses are preserved.

Native/full-network endpoint replay, physical precision, routing/ownership, idle/residual pricing, a complete recursive moment, all-size admission and the selected cold replay are unrun.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only `research/p104-relay-crossing-capacity/` is added. The selected frontier, frozen predecessor evidence and shared verifier code are unchanged.
